title.en: What B500S-83D prints about its delivery hose
title.zh: B500S-83D 对输送胶管印了什么

description.en: B500S-83D is a compact two-stage pump from Xingtai. Its delivery-hose cell says Standard and does not print a DN. The hose spare page also has no fixed size table.
description.zh: B500S-83D 是邢台的紧凑型两级泵。它的输送胶管一格写“标准”，没有印公称直径。胶管配件页也没有固定尺寸表。

h1.en: B500S-83D and the word Standard on the hose cell
h1.zh: B500S-83D 与胶管格上的“标准”

directAnswer.en: B500S-83D Two-Stage Structure Pump is a published compact unit, not a trailer pump and not a truck boom. The sheet says the delivery hose is standard. Diameter, length and a link to the hose spare are missing. Piston and seal sizes are missing.
directAnswer.zh: B500S-83D 两级结构泵是已公布的紧凑机型，不是拖泵，也不是车载臂架。参数写输送胶管为标准。直径、长度以及指向胶管配件的链接都缺失。活塞和密封尺寸缺失。

body.en: Model B500S-83D. Type: two-stage structure pump, manual / electric. Motor 7.5 kW. Voltage 380 V. Delivery height 5 m. Horizontal distance 5 m. Boom: short boom on the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom. Materials: sand and small stone, 5–16 mm. Delivery hose: Standard. Size 915 × 550 × 550 mm. Weight 280 kg.
body.zh: 型号 B500S-83D。型式：两级结构泵，手动 / 电动。电机 7.5 kW。电压 380 V。垂直高度 5 m。水平距离 5 m。臂架：本机短臂架，不是车载布料杆。材料：砂与小石，5–16 mm。输送胶管：标准。外形 915 × 550 × 550 mm。重量 280 kg。

heading.en: What is not on the page

body.en: No DN, no hose length, no wall thickness, no piston outer diameter, no seal kit, no service life. The separate hose product is a rubber placing hose with steel couplings, quoted after model, DN and length. The word Standard does not fill that DN. Electric 20's 80 mm pipe cell is a different machine.
body.zh: 没有公称直径，没有胶管长度，没有壁厚，没有活塞外径，没有密封套件，没有寿命。单独的胶管产品是带金属接头的橡胶布料管，按型号、管径和长度报价。“标准”二字填不上那个管径。电动20的 80 mm 管径格是另一台机器。

body.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Name B500S-83D. Repeat that the hose cell says Standard and that DN is not printed. Leave DN blank unless it was measured on the unit.
body.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明 B500S-83D。重复胶管格的原文是“标准”，公称直径没有印出。除非在机器上量过，否则管径留空。

question.en: Is the short boom a truck placing boom?
question.zh: 短臂架是车载布料杆吗？

answer.en: No. The page says the short boom is on the compact unit and is not a truck-mounted placing boom.
answer.zh: 不是。页面写明短臂架属于本机，不是车载布料杆。

answer.en: No. 5 m is the printed delivery height and the printed horizontal distance.
answer.zh: 不是。5 m 是印出的垂直高度和水平距离。

answer.en: The page does not say that. DN80 is the clamp page, not this hose cell.
answer.zh: 页面没有这样写。DN80 是管卡页，不是这一胶管格。

answer.en: A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank.
answer.zh: 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。

label.en: Email or WhatsApp the Xingtai factory
label.zh: 邮件或 WhatsApp 联系邢台工厂
